13
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, February 24, 2011/Phalguna 5, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Civil Aviation; Development of
North Eastern Region; External Affairs; Overseas Indian Affairs; Personnel,
Public Grievances and Pensions; Planning; Road Transport and
Highways; Shipping; Social Justice and Empowerment;
Space; Steel; Textiles; Tourism; Tribal Affairs;
Women and Child Development; Youth
Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
Agreement between ISRO and DEV AS
*41. DR. T.N. SEEMA: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Antrix Corporation Limited,
set up by Indian Space Research
Organisation (ISRO), has signed any
agreement with M/s DEV AS Multimedia
Private Limited for leasing out two satellites
to be launched by ISRO;
(b) if so, the details of the agreement
and related documents thereof;
(c) whether the contract provides for
use of 70 MHz of S-band spectrum by
M/s DEV AS Multimedia for commercial
use;
(d) the method of selection adopted by
ISRO for allotment of spectrum to the above
firm;
(e) the reasons for open competitive
bidding not adopted for this work; and
(f) the expected revenue from the
contract to Government?
Haj reforms
*42. SHRI  MOHAMMED ADEEB:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Haj reforms
are long overdue; and
(b) if so, the steps Government
proposes to take in the matter?
Funds allocated to Himachal Pradesh
†*43. SHRIMATI BIMLA KASHYAP
SOOD: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) the funds allocated to Himachal
Pradesh under various schemes during
2009-10;
(b) whether Government proposes to
implement any special scheme for
Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes
during ensuing Five Year Plans;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

14
Revision of financial assistance for
SC students
*44. SHRI  PRAVEEN
RASHTRAPAL: W ill the Minister of
SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the action taken by the Ministry to
increase and improve financial assistance/
grant for SC students residing in Government
hostels or hostels managed by NGOs/Trusts
etc. with Government grants;
(b) whether it is a fact that many of the
rates/norms are as old as 1998; and
(c) if so, who is responsible for such
lapse?
Procedure of filing second appeal
under RTI
†*45. SHRI  RASHEED MASOOD:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Ministry has made a
change in the provision of filing second
appeal under the Right to Information Act;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether some Information
Commissioners have themselves devised
the rule for submission of two sets of the
copy of appeal in order to file second appeal
and have made the sending of the copy of
this appeal to the information officer
mandatory before submission of the second
appeal before the Information Commission
at Delhi; and
(d) if so, the steps taken to stop this?
V .K. Shunglu panel report on
irregularities in CWG 2010
*46. SHRI  K.E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of  YOUTH AFFAIRS AND
SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the V .K. Shunglu Panel
appointed to probe the alleged financial
irregularities in organizing the
Commonwealth Games (CWG) has
submitted its report;
(b) if so, the details of its findings and
action taken thereon; and
(c) if not, by when the report is expected
to be submitted?
Status of Bhubaneswar airport
*47. SHRI  RAMA CHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of  CIVIL
A VIA TION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Bhubaneswar airport is
being declared as international airport;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government also has any
plan to develop the Jharsuguda and
Rourkela airports; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Air services in Madhya Pradesh
†*48. MISS ANUSUIYA UIKEY: Will
the Minister of  CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether operational air services in
Madhya Pradesh are sufficient to boost
tourism; if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether Government of Madhya
Pradesh has requested the Government of
India to start air services from Hyderabad
and Chennai to connect Bhopal with South
India and from Bhopal to Kolkata and
Jabalpur to Gwalior to connect it with the
East; and
(c) if so, the action taken for starting
the said air services and by when these
services are likely to be started?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
